import sys, re
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

crispr_raw = pd.read_csv('/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78561440/inputs/dataset_9636c8d0-6d2a-43c6-813c-7499bae129e2.dat', index_col=0)
expr_raw = pd.read_csv('/jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/78561440/inputs/dataset_896d10a3-0b70-4b73-89a9-c7948520f1a7.dat', index_col=0)

def parse_gene(col):
    m = re.match(r'(.+?)\s*\(\d+\)$', str(col))
    return m.group(1) if m else str(col)

crispr_raw.columns = [parse_gene(c) for c in crispr_raw.columns]
expr_raw.columns = [parse_gene(c) for c in expr_raw.columns]

crispr_genes = set(crispr_raw.columns)
expr_genes = set(expr_raw.columns)
common_genes = sorted(crispr_genes & expr_genes)
common_cells = sorted(set(crispr_raw.index) & set(expr_raw.index))

sys.stderr.write(f'Common genes: {len(common_genes)}\n')
sys.stderr.write(f'Common cell lines: {len(common_cells)}\n')

crispr = crispr_raw.loc[common_cells, common_genes]
expr = expr_raw.loc[common_cells, common_genes]

results = []
for gene in common_genes:
    x = crispr[gene].values.astype(float)
    y = expr[gene].values.astype(float)
    mask = ~(np.isnan(x) | np.isnan(y))
    n = mask.sum()
    if n < 3:
        continue
    rho, pval = stats.spearmanr(x[mask], y[mask])
    results.append({'gene': gene, 'rho': float(rho), 'pvalue': float(pval), 'n_pairs': n})

results_df = pd.DataFrame(results)

n = len(results_df)
if n > 0:
    pvals = results_df['pvalue'].values
    sorted_idx = np.argsort(pvals)
    sorted_p = pvals[sorted_idx]
    adj_p = np.minimum(1.0, sorted_p * n / np.arange(1, n + 1))
    for i in range(n - 2, -1, -1):
        adj_p[i] = min(adj_p[i], adj_p[i + 1])
    results_df['adj_pvalue'] = np.nan
    results_df.loc[results_df.index[sorted_idx], 'adj_pvalue'] = adj_p

results_df.to_csv('per_gene_results.tab', sep='\t', index=False, float_format='%.8g')

n_sig = int((results_df['adj_pvalue'] < 0.05).sum())
ntotal = len(results_df)
pct = 100.0 * n_sig / ntotal if ntotal > 0 else 0.0

with open('summary.tab', 'w') as f:
    f.write('metric\tvalue\n')
    f.write(f'total_genes_tested\t{ntotal}\n')
    f.write(f'significant_genes_bh_0.05\t{n_sig}\n')
    f.write(f'significant_percentage\t{pct:.6f}\n')

sys.stderr.write(f'Done. {n_sig} / {ntotal} significant ({pct:.4f}%)\n')
